text_block_list.text:
With the Oka Sho fast approaching, Air
Groove
spots Мэдзиро Добер training with
extreme fervor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Добер is frustrated at herself
because she
believes she's nowhere near
as good as the other
members of the
Mejiro family—Мэдзиро МакКуин
and
Мэдзиро Райан in particular.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
These worries have driven her into
despair.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув announces that she wishes to
guide
her. She vows to show a worthy
performance in
the Triple Tiara and
become an ideal for Dober to
aspire
toward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
